scientific_integrity: The derivation uses a complete four-vertex case classification and conditional independence. Checks use exhaustive samples only as verification, not as a replacement for an all-size proof.
scientific_limitations: Independent and equiprobable edge orientations; no extension to biased or dependent tournament laws.
Orthogonal residual terms are pairwise uncorrelated, not asserted mutually independent.
Exact first-two-moment theorem; no assertion of full joint law or an independently proven priority claim.
The separate means, variances and marginal Gaussian limits are classical (Moran 1947 as summarized by Iyer 2016); novelty is restricted to joint cross-moments and local orthogonal decomposition.
Full texts of Moran (1947) and Andersson (1998) were inaccessible; possible older implicit joint identity remains a priority risk.
title: Exact orthogonal decomposition of three- and four-cycle counts in random tournaments
